name: Get Commit History
description: Fetch commit history for a repository with full details. Supports filtering by branch, author, path, and date range. Handles the list+detail pattern for commit data.

branch.description: Branch name (defaults to repo's default branch)

author.description: Filter by commit author (GitHub username or email)

path.description: Filter by file path (only commits touching this path)

since.description: Only commits after this date (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

until.description: Only commits before this date (ISO 8601 format)
